answer: Pay each agent only its leave-one-out value: after every epoch the ledger recomputes the network's graded output with that identity removed and rewards just the drop. A sybil farm is like a wharf crowded with identical boats; tow one away and the harbour loses nothing, so each copy earns close to zero. A genuine agent adds distinct work, and its absence leaves a visible gap, like a missing plume of smoke over a glacier ridge. Duplicates dilute themselves instead of multiplying payouts.
